responsibility: This header declares the generic stack API used by mc front-end support code. It defines the opaque mcStack_stack handle and exports procedures for creating, destroying, pushing, popping, replacing, measuring depth, and accessing arbitrary stack positions in an address-valued stack.
same_name_distinction: This .h file defines the opaque mcStack_stack type and declares the stack operations for clients. In contrast, the same-stem .cc file contains the actual record layout, Indexing-backed storage management, and error-checked push/pop/access behavior.
